chunks: And he said, from his father, peace be upon him:
If a man is in a state of janabah, he should not eat or drink until he performs wudu (ablution).

key_terms.أَبِيهِ: his father, referring to the preceding Imam in the chain
key_terms.جُنُبًا: in a state of janabah, ritual impurity due to sexual discharge

ai.seo_question: Should a person in a state of janabah eat or drink before performing wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the state of janabah and the etiquette of bodily purity before eating and drinking. It indicates that a junub person should perform wudu (ablution) before eating or drinking.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.181 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) narrates from his father,

Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as):
'If a man is in a state of janabah (ritual impurity due to sexual discharge), he should not eat or drink until he performs wudu (ablution).'.
